sourceMethodSummary: The authors describe denoising individual high-resolution images, then registering and averaging them before manual annotation. The supplied mean is the documented reference; anatomical registration of the supplied raw repetitions has not been independently established.
readerBehavior: All original images retained. Overlays, region navigation and 3D use the prepared mean only. Raw repetitions show images and intensities without an annotation correspondence claim; stale mean decodes cannot restore labels/3D over raw images.
doesNotEstablish: Clinical hippocampal volume thresholds or disease diagnosis
Separate boundaries within the source combined categories
Complete fornix, mammillary-body, cortical or skull-base reporting coverage
